jobs.occupation: Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Oosterhout, Gelderland
jobs.description:
Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Oosterhout, Gelderland. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in and work 12-32 hours per week. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83, including holiday allowance and applicable allowances. 25 vacation days based on full-time employment. Pension accrual. Travel allowance. A flexible position for 12 to 32 hours per week. The opportunity to submit your own availability. Shifts from Monday through Sunday. Morning, afternoon and evening shifts. Practical training with an experienced buddy. Employee discount through the Albert Heijn Bonus Card. Opportunities to develop within the role, for example by becoming a buddy for new drivers. An active job with plenty of variety and time on the road. Opportunities for long-term employment through Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Oosterhout, Gelderland Your working day starts at the Albert Heijn Online location at Linie 11 in Oosterhout, Gelderland. Here, you collect the keys to your delivery van, check the route for your shift and get ready to head out. Once on the road, navigation guides you from one customer to the next. Your route can take you through Oosterhout and other places in the surrounding area, so every shift can look a little different. When you arrive at an address, you select the correct grocery order from the van and check it using a handheld scanner. You then carry the crates to the customer's front door and make sure the order is handed over correctly. Customer contact is an important part of the job. You greet customers in a friendly way, help with questions when necessary and process payments if required. Empty crates and returnable packaging can also be collected before you continue your route. After completing the delivery, you get back behind the wheel and head to the next address. Although driving is a major part of the role, you will not spend your entire shift sitting down. You regularly get in and out of t

van, walk to customers' doors and lift grocery crates. This makes the job a good combination of driving, physical activity and customer service. Once you have completed your final delivery, you return to Linie 11. You finish your route, return the necessary equipment and leave the delivery van ready for the next shift. Do I need experience as a delivery driver? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier is not required. During your first working days, you will be trained by an experienced buddy. You will learn how to use the delivery van, handheld scanner and systems, as well as how to deliver orders and deal with different situations at the customer's door. Once you are familiar with the job, you can start driving your routes independently. Can I submit my own availability? Yes. You can let us know when you are available, and this will be taken into account when the schedule is created. You can work between 12 and 32 hours per week. For this position, you need to be available for at least two shifts per week and at least two Saturdays per month. What does a typical shift involve? You start at Linie 11, collect your van and check your route. You then drive to the customers scheduled for your shift. At each stop, you scan and deliver the groceries, help the customer when needed and collect empty crates. After your final delivery, you return to the location and complete your shift. Can I develop within this role? Yes. Once you have gained experience, there are opportunities to take on additional responsibilities. For example, you may become a buddy and help train new delivery drivers during their first working days.  - Blog - 08 January 2026 Transport People becomes Logistic Force: who is Transport People and why is this step logical for the sector? Transport People: a trusted name in transport and logistics 
Since its founding, Transport People has grown into a well-respected employment agency within the transport and logistics sector. Their approach was clear: act quickly with quality at the center. With offices in Naaldwijk and Maasdijk, Transport People was known for its strong regional involvement in South Holland, particularly in the Westland, Rotterdam, and The Hague areas. They built a strong position by focusing on close relationships with clients and finding the right match with drivers and logistics professionals. 
Transport People stood out through a combination of specialization, a human approach, and dedicated guidance. As a market specialist in transport and logistics, they helped truck drivers and logistics professionals find suitable jobs for nearly 10 years. Like Logistic Force, Transport People always focused on sustainable matches, with job satisfaction as a key priority. Naaldwijk What did Transport People do exactly? 
Until the acquisition by Logistic Force in October 2025, Transport People mainly focused on recruiting and placing professionals in transport and logistics, including: - Truck drivers (C/CE) mainly in sectors such as fresh produce (AGF), flowers and plants, waste management and recycling, distribution, air freight and container transport; - Logistics employees, order pickers, shunters/terminal tractor drivers and forklift and reach truck drivers ; - Clients in transport, logistics, production and supply chain . With strong knowledge of the sector's dynamics, Transport People had long focused on sustainable cooperation.
